sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Which of these shapes has exactly 3 straight sides and 3 corners?
What is the place value of the digit 5 in the number 4562?
What comes next in the number pattern: 2, 4, 6, 8, __?
Which unit is best to measure the length of a small pencil?
How many straight edges does a 3D cube have?
What is the standard form of 3000 + 400 + 20 + 7?
If a pattern is Circle, Square, Triangle, Circle, Square... what is the 6th shape?
How many centimetres are there in 2 metres?
If you share 12 apples equally among 3 children, how many does each get?
Which number comes exactly one less than 5000?
Look at a soda can. Name its mathematical 3D shape and describe its faces. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A soda can is a cylinder. It has two flat circular faces on the top and bottom, and one curved face wrapping around the middle.

questions.question_text: Write the number name for 8,053 and state the place value of the digit 8. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The number name is eight thousand fifty-three. The digit 8 is in the thousands place, so its place value is exactly eight thousand.

questions.question_text: Observe the pattern: 10, 20, 30, 40. What are the next two numbers and what is the rule? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The next two numbers in the sequence are 50 and 60. The rule for this pattern is to simply add 10 to the previous number.

questions.question_text: A piece of rope is 45 cm long. If you cut off a 15 cm piece, how much rope is left? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: To find the remaining rope, we subtract the cut piece from the total length. Subtracting 15 cm from 45 cm leaves exactly 30 cm of rope.

questions.question_text: During a village clean-up, 24 students are divided equally into 4 teams. How many students are in each team? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: To find the team size, we divide the total number of students by the number of teams. Dividing 24 by 4 means each team has 6 students.

questions.question_text: Rahul travels 1250 metres to reach the park from his house. After playing, he walks 800 metres towards his friend's house in the opposite direction. How far is he from his own house now? [40-50 words]
questions.answer: First, Rahul walked 1250 metres away from his house. By walking 800 metres back in the opposite direction, he is getting closer to home. We subtract 800 from 1250, leaving a remaining distance of 450 metres from his house.

questions.question_text: A tailor has a roll of cloth that is 5 metres long. He uses 2 metres 30 centimetres to make a dress. How much cloth is left on the roll? [40-50 words]
questions.answer: First, convert 5 metres to 500 centimetres. The tailor uses 2 metres 30 centimetres, which is 230 centimetres. We subtract 230 from 500, which leaves 270 centimetres. So, the tailor has exactly 2 metres and 70 centimetres of cloth remaining.

sections.section_name: Section D - Mathematical Expression & Data Analysis

questions.question_text: Create a repeating pattern using the letters A, B, and C where the core rule is A-B-B-C. Write down the first 10 terms of this pattern and identify which letter appears at the 9th position. Explain your reasoning. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: The pattern repeats the sequence A, B, B, C. Writing the first ten terms gives: A, B, B, C, A, B, B, C, A, B. The core rule has four terms. The 9th position starts the third cycle of the pattern, so the letter at the 9th position is A.

questions.question_text: Imagine a drawing of a house made entirely of basic 2D shapes. It has a triangular roof, a square body, a rectangular door, and two circular windows. Calculate the total number of straight sides present in all these individual shapes combined. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: The triangle roof has 3 straight sides. The square body has 4 straight sides. The rectangular door has 4 straight sides. The two circular windows have 0 straight sides because they are completely curved. Adding these together, 3 plus 4 plus 4 equals a total of 11 straight sides.
